f2.zh: 我们服务过的家庭与月嫂

f3.en: “Our nanny made the first month with our newborn so much calmer. She knew exactly what to do, and communication was never an issue.”
f3.zh: “月嫂的到来让我们和新生宝宝的第一个月轻松了很多，她非常专业，沟通也完全没有问题。”

f6.en: “The training program gave me the confidence and skills to start this career. I felt genuinely prepared for my first placement.”
f6.zh: “这个培训课程让我有信心和能力开始这份职业，第一次上岗时我感觉自己已经准备得很充分了。”

f9.en: “Professional from the first phone call to the day our nanny left. Highly recommend for any Melbourne family.”
f9.zh: “从第一通电话咨询到月嫂结束服务，整个过程都非常专业，强烈推荐给墨尔本的家庭。”
